# AlphaPo

## Docs

- [Authentication](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/authentication.md)
- [Callbacks overview](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/callbacks/callbacks-overview.md)
- [Deposit callbacks](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/callbacks/deposit-callbacks.md)
- [Exchange callbacks](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/callbacks/exchange-callbacks.md)
- [Payment request callbacks](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/callbacks/payment-request-callbacks.md)
- [Withdrawal callbacks](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/callbacks/withdrawal-callbacks.md)
- [API currency codes](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/currency-codes.md): Use these codes in your API requests
- [List balances](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/accounts-list.md): Get a list of your balances for each cryptocurrency, including zero balances.
- [Generate a user deposit address](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/addresses-take.md): Generate a deposit address for a user
- [Withdraw crypto instantly](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/crypto-withdrawal-instant.md): Make an [instant withdrawal](https://docs.alphapo.net/withdrawals#instant-withdrawals) from a cryptocurrency balance.
- [Withdraw crypto instantly with conversion](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/crypto-withdrawal-instant-exchange.md): Make an [instant withdrawal](https://docs.alphapo.net/withdrawals#instant-withdrawals) from a cryptocurrency or fiat balance with conversion to cryptocurrency.
- [List supported currencies](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/currencies-list.md): Returns a list of available currencies, minimum deposit amounts, and deposit and withdrawal fees.
- [Get exchange rates](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/currencies-rates.md): Get available currency pairs and exchange rates.
- [Get a fixed exchange quote](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/exchange-calculate.md): Get a fixed exchange quote for a specific amount, which can then be used with [/exchange/fixed](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/exchange-fixed).
- [Exchange at a fixed rate](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/exchange-fixed.md): Execute an exchange using a valid fixed quote from [/exchange/calculate](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/exchange-calculate).
- [Exchange at market rate](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/exchange-now.md): Execute an exchange immediately at the currently available market rate, without requesting a fixed quote.
- [Create a payment request](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/payments.md): Create a payment request for the client for a specified amount and a configurable expiration time.
- [Check API status](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/ping.md): Test if your API connection is working.
- [Get transaction details](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/transactions-info.md): Get transaction details by `id`, `foreign_id`, or `txid`. Include only one of these parameters in your request.
- [Withdraw crypto](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/endpoints/withdrawal-crypto.md): Withdraw in crypto to any address.
- [Errors](https://docs.alphapo.net/api-reference/errors.md)
